component.name: Plasma Mail
component.summary: A simple IMAP mail client for Plasma

description.p: Plasma Mail is a simple mail client for KDE Plasma. It talks IMAP and SMTP directly and does not need Akonadi.

ul.li: Yahoo, Gmail (Google sign-in) and any other IMAP provider, several accounts at once
Conversations, local storage with import date, keep time and size limits
Push mail (IMAP IDLE) and new-mail notifications
Compose, reply and forward, with recipient autocomplete from your contacts
Messages are shown without remote content and without JavaScript
